kind: Static analysis of the server image
search_scope: Scalar D-form loads, lmw and addi with a nonzero base register and an immediate within the field. The load search tests byte-range intersection with offsets 0x41c through 0x41f. Register values are not inferred by the scan. Indexed loads, pointer aliases and split base calculations are outside its coverage.
projection: Program identity omits two local path fields. Query arguments and results are retained.
